items.name: agent-ui-runtime
items.title: Agent UI Runtime
items.description: The capability kernel, registry, WebMCP bridge and hooks that every agent-native component binds to.

items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: The cn helper that merges Tailwind class names, required by every component.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A polymorphic button with variant and size presets, styled for agent-driven interfaces.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: An accessible form label built on Radix Label.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Primitive table elements with consistent styling, used as the rendering layer for DataTable.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: A tabbed container whose active tab is readable and selectable by an agent.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A dropdown select whose chosen value and options are readable and settable by an agent.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A checkbox whose checked state is readable and settable by an agent.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal dialog whose open state and title are readable and controllable by an agent.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A text input whose value is readable and settable by an agent through the native value channel.

items.name: data-table
items.title: DataTable
items.description: A TanStack-powered data table exposing filter, sort, row selection, pagination and column visibility to an agent.
